title: Broken bows
description:
Added 3 kinds of broken bows
添加了3种破损的弓
body:
Broken Bows(The MOD) is a unique mod for Java Minecraft 1.19.2 (Forge) that introduces a realistic bow degradation and repair system. It adds three broken variants: Bow with Broken String, Bow with Broken Stick, and Fully Broken Bow, which cannot be used normally but can be restored via crafting.

Key Features:
Dynamic Breaking System

When a normal bow’s durability depletes, it has a 60% chance to break (20% string, 20% stick, 20% both) or 40% chance to vanish.

Holding a drawn bow for over 6 seconds may damage it (47% string, 47% stick, 6% both), with arrows flying only 2 to 4 blocks.

Repair Mechanics (shapeless):

Broken String Bow + String → Normal Bow

Broken Stick Bow + Stick → Normal Bow

Fully Broken Bow + String + Stick → Normal Bow

Immersive Details:

Broken bows cannot be drawn and play a "snap" sound when clicked.

All variants are grouped under a Creative Mode tab named "Bow Workshop"

破损弓(此模组)是一款为Java版Minecraft 1.19.2 Forge设计的趣味模组，为游戏中的弓箭系统增添了更真实的损坏与修复机制。这个模组引入了三种破损状态的弓：断弦的弓、断柄的弓和完全损坏的弓，它们无法正常使用，但可以通过合成修复回普通弓。

核心玩法：
动态损坏系统

当普通弓的耐久耗尽时，有60%概率变成破损弓（20%破弦、20%断柄、20%双损），40%概率直接消失。

拉弓超过6秒后，弓可能因受力过大而损坏（47%破弦、47%断柄、6%双损），同时箭仅飞出2至4格距离。

修复机制（无序合成）：

断弦弓 + 线 → 修复为普通弓

断柄弓 + 木棍 → 修复为普通弓

完全损坏的弓 + 线 + 木棍 → 修复为普通弓

真实细节:

破损弓无法拉弓，右键时会播放断裂音效。

创造模式中所有破损弓归类在独立标签页“弓械工坊”中。
